grain_rationale: The profile shows duplicate_row_rate 0.0 over 44721 rows and the silver contract declares (invoice_id, stock_code, quantity, unit_price) unique, so one line is one event: transaction grain with one derived identity over the declared tuple.

fields.name: invoice_id
fields.description: Invoice number; a C prefix marks a cancellation (2330 distinct, null_rate 0.0).

fields.name: is_cancellation
fields.description: Cancellation flag; exclusion is a consumer decision (2 distinct).

fields.name: quantity
fields.description: Units on the line; negative only on cancellations.

fields.name: invoiced_at
fields.description: Invoice timestamp; the declared time column.

fields.name: unit_price
fields.description: Unit price in sterling; zero-price lines retained.

fields.name: customer_id
fields.description: Customer identifier; null on guest checkouts.

category_description: One fact category: line-level retail sales at transaction grain; cancellations flow through retained-and-flagged.
purpose: Declares how silver.silver_invoice_lines maps into the unified event star as the invoice_lines fact category.
usage: Engine input only. Gate 1 lints it; gate 3 skips it by design (F-12); the engine validates it against mapping-contract.schema.json.
limitations: Cancellation lines flow through retained-and-flagged; excluding them is a consumer decision made at query time, never here.
